notes.title: Mega Hasan Runs Windowed Now
notes.notes: Mega Hasan now runs windowed by default.  You can toggle between full screen and windowed mode in settings.

notes.title: You can also move with WASD
notes.notes: Didn't feel like making an update just to explain that.. but just in case you're left handed and dont feel like using the arrow keys..  WASD works.

notes.title: For Mac Users
notes.notes:
You may experience performance issues running your display on scaled mode.

If the frame rate is bad make sure your display settings look like this:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/bkXB9mB.png[/img]

notes.title: If you had trouble installing
notes.notes: Please restart steam and reinstall game =)
